description: This file defines the interface for a PUCCH (Physical Uplink Control Channel) processor supporting multiple formats (0 to 4) in a 3GPP NR (5G) context. It includes configuration structures for each format, processing methods, and a validator interface, with references to 3GPP specifications and related components.

classes.name: ocudu::pucch_processor
classes.description: Interface for processing various PUCCH formats (0-4), including configuration structures and processing methods.

classes.name: ocudu::pucch_pdu_validator
classes.description: Interface for validating PUCCH configuration parameters.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes a PUCCH message of a specific format (0-4) given resource grid and configuration.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Validates configuration parameters for each PUCCH format.
